```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

# Objectives 

To assess the validity of primary and hospital care resource use and costs estimated based on OMOP-mapped CPRD data against its corresponding source data using a cohort of women with postmenopausal fragility fractures in the UK.

The cohort of interest is made of women aged >50 years with an incident fragility fracture in any site except the face, skull or digits and no history of fracture in the two years prior. The outcomes of interest are *primary* and *secondary healthcare resource utilisation* and *direct costs* associated to first incident fracture measured during the 730 days post index date or until a censoring event occurs and expressed as values per person/year. A detailed analysis plan for this study is available [here](https://github.com/LucyNjokiNjuki/OMOP-Validation-Study/raw/refs/heads/main/Analysis_plan_V.2_final.docx).

This RMarkdown reports the data preparation and results for the analysis conducted on the *source CPRD-HES* dataset. 

# Data Preparation

The attrition table below shows the steps we followed to clean and prepare the data for the analysis.

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(here)
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(rvest)
library(DT)
library(png)
library(grid)
```


```{r}
attrition_report <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_Raw.xlsx"))


attrition_report %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Attrition table**")
  ) %>%
  #opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) 
```

# Results 

## Table 1

```{r}
# Import data
# table1_data <- read_html(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "gt_summary_table_Raw.html")) %>% 
#   html_node("table") %>%
#   html_table()

# Import data
table1_data <- rio::import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Table1_Raw.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))

# Define parent variables and subcategories
parent_vars <- c("Fracture Site", "Censoring Event",
                 "User Status", "Non-user Visits Status")  

subcategories <- c("Hip", "Vertebra", "NHNV", 
                   "Cancer", "Cancer, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Death", "End of data collection period",
                   "End of data collection period, Cancer",
                   "End of data collection period, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Cancer",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, End of data collection period",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases",
                   "Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases",
                   "Non-User", "User",
                   "No Visits", "Visits with Non-clinically Relevant Staff")

# Add indentation dynamically
table1_data <- table1_data %>%
  mutate(Variable = case_when(
    Variable %in% subcategories ~ paste0("&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;", Variable), # Indent subcategories using HTML space
    TRUE ~ Variable
  ))

# Create gt table with a footnote
table1_data %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Patient Characteristics**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = "Variable") %>%  # Apply markdown formatting for indentation
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Median (Q1, Q3); n (%)",
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")) %>% 
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md("*User defined as subjects with >=1 visit with a clinically relevant healthcare provider and Non-User as Subjects with no visits, or visits with non-clinically relevant healthcare provider*"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Variable,
                           rows = c(21))
  )

```


## Primary care {.tabset}

### Healthcare resource utilisation (HCRU)

```{r}
all_summary_statistics_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "all_summary_statistics")

all_summary_statistics_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**All Patients - Visits per patient per year**"),
    subtitle = md("*Users and non-users*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      table.width = px(800),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile"
  )
```

```{r}
user_only_summary_statistics_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary_statistics")

user_only_summary_statistics_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Service users - Visits per patient per year**"),
    subtitle = md("*Subjects with >=1 visit with a clinically relevant healthcare provider*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      table.width = px(800),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD ",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median ",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile"
  )
```


```{r}
#                 targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
#                 className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
#             )
#         )
#     )
# )

datatable(user_only_summary_rp,
    rownames = FALSE, 
    filter = 'top', 
    options = list(
        scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
        search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
        autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
        columnDefs = list(
          list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
            list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
            list(
                targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
                className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
            )
        ),
        initComplete = JS(
            "function(settings, json) {",
            "$(this.api().table().body()).css({'font-family': 'Times New Roman', 'font-size': '16px'});",
            "}"
        )
    )
)
```

## Assumptions Underlying Cost Calculations

```{r}
provider_cost_inputs_rp <- rio::import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "SRC",  "provider_specialty_cprd_V.0.3_summarised.xlsx")) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  select(!include) %>% 
  select(specialty_source_value, specialty_source_value_summarised, everything())

colnames(provider_cost_inputs_rp) <- c("Specialty", "Specialty Reduced", "Unit Cost", "Source PSSRU 2023 Unless Stated Otherwise (Assumptions)")
```


```{r}
datatable(provider_cost_inputs_rp,
    rownames = FALSE, 
    filter = 'top', 
    options = list(
        scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
        search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
        autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
        columnDefs = list(
            list(
                targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
                className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
            )
        )
    )
)
```
